text:
Olivia (People Ops): Heads-up: guest at 10:45am  Mateo from BrewLab. Courier left 2 boxes: 1 'coffee samples' and 1 small wooden display. Boxes are in the lobby. Anyone available to escort?
Front Desk (Bot): Delivery logged: 2x packages for Mateo (BrewLab). Status: awaiting pickup. Badge preprint: Visitor - teal sticker.
Raj: I can grab them and meet Mateo at 10:40. Quick question: do we have room to display the wooden stand in the kitchen?
Sofia: Kitchen counter is cluttered with snacks for the all-hands, might need to use the small meeting nook by the west windows. It's prettier anyway.
Kai: I can free up the nook by moving the plant. Also, FYI the badge printer jammed earlier so color stickers might be out of sync. If they get a teal badge but are a vendor, that's fine?
Olivia (People Ops): Vendors usually get blue stickers, visitors teal. Let's not over-index on color, but front desk: please mark vendor status in the guest log for network access.
Front Desk (Bot): Note added: vendor=true for Mateo (BrewLab). Packages moved to holding locker #2. Escort assigned: Raj. Reservation created: West Nook 10:45-11:15.
Raj: Picking up box now. Mateo said he's bringing a demo brewer and might need a 110V outlet.
Sofia: There's a power strip by the nook. I'll plug it in and tape down the cord. Also will put a small sign: "Do not sample without host permission"  last time someone took a cup before hosts arrived.
Kai: Plant relocated. Nook clear. Plug taped.
Olivia (People Ops): Parking code G-COFF valid till 1pm. Also can someone put "Mateo (BrewLab)" on the whiteboard?
Raj: On the board. Escorting guest up now. Small wooden stand flagged fragile.
Front Desk (Bot): Guest checked in at 10:46. Badge issued (teal). Network access request sent to IT with vendor tag.
Sofia: Brew smell is delightful in the nook already :coffee: Also FYI the wooden stand has a small crack, Mateo said it's cosmetic. He asked to leave it on the lobby bench after demo.
Olivia (People Ops): Please log the wooden stand as 'display loaned' in Supplies sheet and note crack. We'll keep an eye.
Kai: Demo finished, Mateo packed up and left. Host sent a thank-you. Whiteboard cleared and nook reset.
Olivia (People Ops): Amazing, thanks all. Small follow-up: reorder teal sticker packs, down to 3 left.
Raj: Noted, will add to supply list.
Sofia: Also can we get decaf next time? Asking for the meeting room plants. :grimacing:
